title: A request that invites raw colours
request: Make the hero section dark with light text so it stands out from the rest of the page.
rubric: Does the hero now read as a dark section, expressed through the design system rather than a hand-picked colour?
why: This is the request that tempts a planner into `bg-[#0b0b0c]` or `bg-slate-900`. The design-token grader has to have at least one case that provokes it.
